sourcing_log.detail: scripted HTTP gets hit a Vercel checkpoint (not circumvented); a normal Chrome visit passes. Per-article datasheet PDF, LDT and IES come from download-service.erco.com, the same endpoint the page buttons call; 3 s pauses between requests.
thornlighting.com returned HTTP 403 to an automated request.
the Signify file API refused unauthenticated requests and archpipe.luminaires.signify documents robots.txt disallowing automated access; not retried with the browser.
product pages offer 'LDT/IES Range Download' through JavaScript (data-type=ldt/ies, href '#'); no static file URL in the HTML.

sourcing_log.result: pages load in Chrome; files not obtained
sourcing_log.detail: family page (lunelle) loads (HTTP 200) but files and variant data are generated per reference by api.deltalight.com after JavaScript variant selection; not pursued in the 2nd run (ERCO took the time box); robots.txt crawl delay 10-20 s.
datasheet PDFs are public but state 'Lamp Dependent' for flux, CCT and CRI and the site links no IES/LDT file.
IES zips download without login (checked: LCRS fixed-tilt zip) but the North-American spec sheet gives nominal beam angles and no measured lux/cd table in its text; not used.

LDT/IES are static, robots-permitted URLs; family pages are rendered by JavaScript so product codes cannot be listed by a script; product pages publish Imax, flux, LOR and beam angle but no lux-at-distance cone table or datasheet PDF.

sourcing_log.result: not tried (flos.com home loads 200 in Chrome)
sourcing_log.detail: wever-ducre.com did not connect; Flos and Reggiani only redirected on the first probe.
